title: Grade 2 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #3

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

2. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   B. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   D. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Specific morning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Specific morning has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Specific morning to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Specific morning with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Specific morning.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Religious has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.
   C. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kalpasutra and Dhammapada.
   B. Use Kalpasutra and Dhammapada to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Kalpasutra and Dhammapada has no place in daily life.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

10. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Qualities of has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities of.
   C. Use Qualities of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Qualities of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Specific morning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Qualities of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kalpasutra and Dhammapada and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. D — Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
